title: [nightly/speed] Read a round's or course's detail alongside the golfer's index
summary: Opening a round or a course reads the page's data and the golfer's handicap index (their last 20 rounds) at the same time instead of one after the other. The ownership check still runs first, so nothing else is read for someone else's round.
